# Class property blocks can nest within sections
==================
class nested properties
==================

class Widget
  events:
    theme:
      dark: true

---

(source_file
  (statement_sequence
    (statement
      (class_definition
        (identifier)
        (class_body
          (class_indented_body
            (class_member
              (class_property_block
                (identifier)
                (class_property_member
                  (class_property_block
                    (identifier)
                    (class_property_member
                      (class_property_assignment
                        (identifier)
                        (expression
                          (boolean))))))))))))))
